decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 9 backtested attempts, score 0.4833. Series context: trend strength 0.7946 and seasonal strength 0.9357; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.088); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.935.
